the proposed simulation based coyote algorithm is a good candidate for tuning the PI controller gains of the DC link voltage controller and the speed of the rotor controller in a solar PV water pumping system, to achieve the desired performance.
the proposed COA is a powerful and robust algorithm for solving the optimization problems in water pumping system powered with solar PV.
the COA algorithm was successfully used for optimizing the PI controller gains for enhancing the performance of a solar PV powered water pumping system, under partial shading conditions.

the development of a simulation based coyot optimization algorithm for the identification of the PI controllers gains for the enhancement of the performance of a solar water pumping system.
the design of a solar PV water pumping system with the capability to operate autonomously, i.e. in a stand alone mode.
the development of an optimized PI controller using the COA algorithm for the DC link and the rotor speed dynamics of the PV water pump system.
